tara: quickpulse — yesterday: landed onboarding PR for finance promptset (PR #7893). Ran full eval overnight; reranker recall on long-context (>=4k) dropped ~4% compared to baseline. can't reproduce locally w/ default seed 42 yet; suspect quant fallback path. blocking: need someone to help reproduce or give a reproducer.

sahil: link to logs? can you paste the exact eval command & seed? I can try on my dev box later today.

tara: thanks — command below, seed=42; logs at https://redwood-internal/ci/4567
```
rwd eval run --model rwd-llama3-14b --promptset prompts/finance/long-context --seed 42 --batch 8 --metric reranker_recall@10
```
I also noticed p95 latency on dedicated rose from 220ms -> 360ms during warmup window.

jess: I'll take a look at PR #7893 this afternoon, leaving a quick note in codeowner. :eyes:

michael: for the kv-warmup, try toggling `kv_cache_warmup_steps` to 128 in the deployment config. quick override:
```
service:
  kv_cache_warmup_steps: 128
  autoscale: { min:1, max:4 }
```
should help cut the p95 spike, but be careful with memory on smaller GPUs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for rwd-llama3-14b-quant in us-west-2 (10% traffic). Monitor: /dash/models/rwd-llama3-14b-quant/canary

evalbot: ALERT: regression detected in `reranker_recall@10` for promptset `prompts/finance/long-context` (baseline 0.812 -> current 0.777, -4.3%). See run 4567 for diffs.

tara: ok thanks @sahil @jess — pairing at 11:00 PT works for me. If we don't find a repro I'll open a rollback PR and trigger the canary halt. :thumbsup:
